capabilities: Customize storage paths and file names
disambiguation: Not limited to images; it supports a wide range of file types including documents, archives, and code files.
intentEvidence: Local any files: Flexible scope options (current file, folder, entire vault, or single items)
problem: External links in notes often point to inaccessible online resources, requiring local copies for reliable note viewing.

relations.evidence: While obsidian-local-images is a great plugin focused on image attachments, obsidian-local-any-files extends similar functionality to a much wider range of file types

summary: A plugin that extracts, downloads, and replaces external links in notes with local file paths, supporting a wide variety of file types.
